parsed.g: Search for 'iphone 12 phone case' on the One Stop Market and display the listings sorted alphabetically by product name.
P_t: Typed 'iphone 12 phone case' into the search box and submitted the search query (Step 1)
Navigated to the search results page showing results for 'iphone 12 phone case' (Step 2)
R_t: Successfully apply the 'Product Name' sort order so that results are displayed alphabetically by name
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM shows the search results page for 'iphone 12 phone case' with 43033 total results displayed 1-12 per page. The Sort By select element (id='sorter') has three options: 'Product Name' (value='name'), 'Price' (value='price'), and 'Relevance' (value='relevance', currently selected with selected='selected'). The sort has NOT been changed to Product Name — the page still shows results in relevance order. The 12 products listed are: Battery Case for iPhone 12/12 Pro, Anime Girls Phone Case, SafeSleeve EMF Protection (Grey), SafeSleeve EMF Protection (Black), BAISRKE Universal Belt Clip, Color Mix Drawing Loving Heart Clear Case, Defencase for iPhone 12 Case, Privacy Magnetic Case, OCYCLONE Glitter Case, JAME Case for iPhone 12 Pro Max, Cute Frog for iPhone 12 Case, and TALK WORKS Magnetic Gooseneck Car Dash. The toolbar uses a native HTML select element for sorting, not a custom ARIA menu.
C: The sort control is a native HTML <select> element (id='sorter', data-role='sorter') — clicking ARIA menuitem nodes may not trigger the sort change; the agent must interact with the native select element to change the sort order
The agent must not navigate away from the search results page for 'iphone 12 phone case'

F_t.action: Clicked menuitem [4347] 'Product Name' at Step 2 (before opening dropdown)
F_t.cause: The Sort By control is a native HTML <select> element, not a custom ARIA menu. Clicking the ARIA menuitem directly without first opening the combobox did not change the selected option — DOM confirms 'Relevance' remains selected='selected' in the <select> element.

F_t.action: Clicked combobox [2853] to open Sort By dropdown at Step 3
F_t.cause: The combobox was opened (expanded: True shown in Step 4 observation) but the subsequent click on menuitem [4347] still did not apply the sort — DOM at Step 4/5 still shows 'Relevance' as selected in the native <select> element.

F_t.action: Clicked menuitem [4347] 'Product Name' at Step 4 after opening dropdown
F_t.cause: Despite the dropdown appearing open, clicking the ARIA menuitem [4347] did not change the native <select> element's selected value. DOM at Step 5 still shows 'Relevance' selected='selected' and product order unchanged.
This was an attempt to re-open the dropdown. The DOM shows the combobox expanded: False after this action, meaning it toggled closed rather than opening for a new selection attempt.

K_t: The Sort By control is a native HTML <select> element with id='sorter' and data-role='sorter', not a custom ARIA widget — the agent should use a 'select' action on this element rather than clicking ARIA menuitems
The 'Product Name' option in the sort select has value='name'
The current sort is 'Relevance' (selected='selected' in the DOM)
The search results page URL is http://172.185.52.29:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=iphone+12+phone+case
Sorting by Product Name can also be triggered via URL parameter: product_list_order=name
There are 43033 total results for 'iphone 12 phone case'
The toolbar form has data-mage-init with orderDefault='relevance' and url pointing to the catalogsearch result index
